text:
My nephew taught me more about leadership than any MBA ever could.

This morning, they quietly translated for a lost traveler.

At first, I saw a problem.

Then I realized: this wasn't defiance. It was a request for autonomy.

And suddenly I understood why change management is mostly listening.

The best frameworks are learned at breakfast, not in business school.

What's one lesson you've learned recently?
